claim: CGEL includes dummy there on distributional grounds.
evidence_summary: There occupies the subject slot and can itself appear as the subject of a question tag.
finding: Tag behaviour independently supports the pronoun analysis, despite limited distribution.
inference: Does the subject and tag distribution of dummy there support its placement with pronouns?

evidence.passage: §1, p. 328. CGEL includes dummy there on distributional grounds.
evidence.example: Compare existential There is a problem with its tag isn’t there? The position after the inverted verb in the tag independently identifies the subject form.
evidence.establishes: The distribution supplies evidence for the pronominal analysis of unstressed existential there even though it lacks an ordinary referent.
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
